theme: Canonical professional portal identity and D3 local adapter verification

improvements.problem: Professional assignments used historical identifiers that did not match current portal contracts.
improvements.result: Mapped only unambiguous aliases and generated 678 canonical assignments.

improvements.problem: Mixed or safety-oriented legacy identifiers could not be mapped safely.
improvements.result: Kept 14 assignments outside portal exports with explicit reasons and next actions.

improvements.problem: D2 contracts did not prove local consumer behavior.
improvements.result: Added 25 D3 local read-only adapter fixtures, including valid empty-state tests.

improvements.problem: Live producer-consumer connections lack staging authorization and operational controls.
improvements.result: No live connection or automatic write was added.

improvements.problem: No independently researched clean current source batch was available in this artifact-focused release.
improvements.result: Added zero profiles and preserved exact totals.

ownerBenefit: The owner can see which professional assignments reach each current legal portal, which legacy records remain unresolved, and whether every local adapter fixture passes without opening a live connection.
portalBenefit: Dedicated portals receive a versioned, validated, canonical, nonconfidential handoff shape that can later support a controlled staging adapter.
publicUserBenefit: Professional placement remains evidence-based, payment-independent, and protected from unsafe category inference.
